description: Curated ATT&CK mitigation to CME crosswalks. ATT&CK objects stay external; CME remains the source of truth for concrete, verifiable controls.

attack_bindings.rationale: CME-201 is a concrete identity-aware gateway implementation of ATT&CK's broader network resource access restriction mitigation.
CME-201 is a concrete access-management enforcement point for ATT&CK ICS remote-service access control.
CME-202 is a host-level implementation of ATT&CK Filter Network Traffic.
CME-202 is a host-level implementation of ATT&CK ICS Filter Network Traffic.
CME-203 is a concrete network-zone implementation of ATT&CK Network Segmentation.
CME-203 is a concrete VLAN/subnet implementation of ATT&CK ICS Network Segmentation.
CME-206 is a Kubernetes-native traffic-filtering implementation of ATT&CK Filter Network Traffic.
CME-801 is a concrete ATT&CK Multi-factor Authentication control with verification guidance.
CME-801 is a concrete ATT&CK ICS Multi-factor Authentication control.
CME-806 is a concrete mutual-authentication implementation of ATT&CK ICS Software Process and Device Authentication.
